1.3.3.description: The upstream `pipeline/default_params_schema.json` at pipeline v1.3.3, extended to declare the SpikeInterface DREDGE keyword arguments `batching_mode` and `chunk_len_s` under `preprocessing.motion_correction.estimate_motion_kwargs`.
